candidates.title: Hourly output peaks 10:20 at 133 pcs with a sharp midday dip
candidates.rationale: Trend over shift-day 09:20–19:20 using 時間当 (hourly good qty). The line shows a peak of 133 pcs at 10:20, a drop to 12 pcs at 14:10, and recovery to 89 pcs at 15:20. The 12:xx gap is inherent to the time_span (09:20–19:20).

candidates.title: New builds split: FD31[9] dominates output with zero FD03[7] after 10:20
candidates.rationale: Bar split of new builds per model using FD03[7] and FD31[9]. FD31[9] drives the volume (max 113 at 11:20) while FD03[7] appears only at 10:20 (32 pcs) and is zero elsewhere. All rework columns are constant 0.

candidates.title: Hourly production and effort details
candidates.rationale: Exact values for 時間当, 累計, new builds, and net seconds. Target is constant 0 and omitted from chart. Rework is constant 0 and omitted.

questions.q: What caused the production collapse to 12 pcs at 14:10 after 113 pcs at 11:20?
questions.why: Mid-shift dip unclosable from this set — needs downtime or material cause.
